questions.text: Scope: oil-immersed distribution transformers rated up to and including 33 kV.
This procedure does not apply to motors, cables, generators or dry-type transformers; such requests are out of scope.
Step 2 temperature correction: correct the insulation resistance to 20 degrees Celsius by multiplying it by 2 raised to the power of (top-oil temperature minus 20) divided by 15.
